name: Gizmo
description: Gizmo offers a no-card monthly quota on zero-cost API models.
overview: Gizmo's Free account permits 1,000 zero-cost-model API requests per calendar month, resetting on the first day in UTC, and 20 API requests per minute. The official Nemotron 3 Ultra :free model page lists both input and output at $0 and says these calls do not consume the separate weekly dollar allowance. Paid models and tools can incur charges and may require a payment method.
free_access: 1,000 free-model API requests per calendar month
Zero-cost models do not consume weekly dollar allowance
notes: Use nvidia/nemotron-3-ultra-550b-a55b:free rather than its paid alias. Admitted requests count against the quota even if the upstream fails; paid models or tools are separate.
